modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: organize work as per the organization’s health, safety and security policies and procedures
identify the risks and hazards associated while driving and their causes and preventions
check and ensure the functioning of vehicle before commencing work
identify and report vehicle maintenance and repair requirements/risks as per SOP, if any
take corrective measures and follow standard first-aid procedures in case of an accident
ensure safety of all passengers and immediately report any breaches to the appropriate authority
ensure vehicle and equipment are regularly cleaned and sanitized
wash hands with soap and use alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose of PPEs regularly and appropriately
report hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority, if any
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify ways to optimize usage of fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) in the vehicle
use resources in a responsible manner
check for spills/leakages in the vehicle with caution
plug spills/leakages of fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG), oil/coolant or water from the vehicle and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of the vehicle
ensure the various equipment of the vehicle is properly connected

kus: KU1. procedure to wash external structure of the vehicle such as the body, tyres, windshield, rear
KU2. precautions to be taken while washing a vehicle and protecting vital components
KU3. procedure to perform vehicle rubbing while pre-wash
KU4. types of surfactants and cloth to be used for the cleaning process
KU5. procedure to clean the internal parts of the vehicle like dashboard, instrument panel, seats,
KU6. standard checklist to ensure correct levels of the engine oil, coolant, battery fluid level, brake
KU7. procedure to perform technical checks on a vehicle
KU8. constituents of a tool box and their placement
KU9. how to assist driver in maintaining logs, servicing or minor repairs
gs: GS1. read and interpret the instructions, procedures, information and signages at the workplace
GS3. complete tasks efficiently and accurately within the stipulated time

pcs.pc_description: check for water supply in the pipe and ensure optimum pressure is maintained through the nozzle after starting the water pump
wash external body of the vehicle such as doors, side panels, roof, tyres, windshield, rear view mirrors, etc. thoroughly with running water to remove settled dirt/dust
PC3. ensure the water does not enter vehicle engine components like injectors, air filter, starter motor, alternator, horn, etc.
rub the surfactant (washing liquid) on the wet external surface of the vehicle properly with a micro fiber cloth to clean the settled loose dust and dirt
spray evenly the running water on the surfactant applied parts of the vehicle to wash out the residue deposited on the vehicle completely
wipe and dry the external body of the vehicle with another micro fiber clean cloth
wipe clean the vehicle internal parts of the vehicle like dashboard, instrument panel, seats, steering wheel, floor mats etc.
make sure there are no visible stains on the vehicle after washing
report loose/broken/missing parts like floor mats, wheel cover, mountings, seals, bolts/nuts, chassis fasteners, if any

modules.module_title: Perform basic technical check on the vehicle

pcs.pc_description: check and ensure correct levels of the engine oil, coolant, battery fluid level, brake oil, water in windshield storage tank and proper functioning of clutch
check vehicle tyres for any wear and optimum tyre thread depth and spare tyre for inflation using pressure gauge and ensure correct pressure in tyres
ensure proper functioning of all lights, wipers, and horn and report to the driver in case of any malfunctioning
check the tool box and confirm the availability of all the hand tools including jack, props, wheel choke, etc.
examine the exterior and interior parts of the vehicle properly for any damages to body panels, lights, windshield, other glass parts, and mirrors
inform the driver in case of any problem observed during the routine check-up of the vehicle in any of the checkpoints

modules.module_title: Assist driver in delivery log, servicing or minor repairs

pcs.pc_description: provide the required tools and equipment to the driver to repair any fault
assist the driver in strenuous jobs like lifting of vehicle by jack in case of punctured tyre replacement, opening of screws and fixtures for lights, wiper, loading/unloading of goods, etc.
provide assistance to the driver in filling the engine/brake/coolant oil and other fluids to ensure optimum levels and maintain a list of all deliveries
